scope: preregistration; runtime scorer adoption is pending
freeze_before_results: per-slot workload size and minimum scheduled work per block

estimator.workload_floor_rule: schedule a full preregistered workload in each A/B slot and meet the block floor for each side; freeze workload size and duration bound before scoring, and retain failed or unverified scheduled work
estimator.resampling_unit: whole matched block with both arms and all attempts
estimator.confidence_interval: paired percentile at probabilities 0.025 and 0.975; linearly interpolate sorted draws at zero-based index (n - 1) * p
estimator.statistic: recompute the registered arm statistic from pooled observations in each matched resample

ratio_pooling.P: sum verified receipts / sum independent outer elapsed seconds
ratio_pooling.U: sum participating cgroup CPU seconds / sum verified frames

estimator.invalid_ratio_denominator: zero or unavailable pooled denominator leaves qualification open
estimator.invalid_baseline: zero or unavailable A leaves relative qualification open
estimator.latency_quantile: nearest rank over scheduled attempts; a candidate quantile is identified only if all censoring lower bounds are at or above it
estimator.missing_completion: misses its slot and is right censored at its frozen deadline unless the arm explicitly charges a timeout
estimator.unidentified_p95_or_invalid_resample: qualification open; retain the censor, never silently discard a bootstrap draw
estimator.rejected_pairs: log both halves, rejection reason and matched replacement before scoring
estimator.random_generator: Python random.Random(seed), drawing randrange(block_count) per sampled block

budget_statistic: upper paired confidence bound; all applicable bounds must pass per profile
amendment_policy: prospective only; amendments cannot soften planner budgets, common KEEP/DISCARD gates, the U protected-tail guardrail or T1/T2 thresholds

instrument.breach: block timed optimisation verdicts; recorder remains available for diagnosis
instrument.interval_share_attribution: measure instrumentation time on the enabled arm using calibrated independent attribution inside the outer interval; document attribution method and avoid double counting overlapping time
instrument.scope_baseline: calibrated complete enabled and empty intervals with matched scope counts, entry path and clock; divide elapsed difference by complete enabled scopes

private_start_watcher.grant: record measured and required values; expires at launch

decision.default: normal for marginal, undecided or unmeasured profiles
decision.precedence: reject invalid measurements before speed scoring; a verified correctness regression discards; test KEEP and DISCARD boundaries before MARGINAL
